verdict.rationale: The only evidence of event-triggered automation is brute-force protection, a built-in rule that automatically disables accounts after too many login failures. Beyond that, the pack has only generic claims of extensibility through code and custom providers, so user-defined event-to-action rules would require custom development and are not documented. Missing for 10: a user-definable rule or workflow engine, documented event listeners or webhooks that trigger actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
